title: Alien Portal Ritual
description: A surreal triptych-style illustration split into vertical panels featuring a leaping woman with white hair and tribal markings. She holds a glowing orb containing a screaming face while multiple large three-eyed alien beings with geometric patterns float above. Lavender flowers, skulls, lightning bolts, and a red rocky landscape appear throughout the composition.
